en.t: "My ears hurt," Takeichi said, standing there.
"When water gets in your ears, they start to hurt."

units.source_text: 我仔細一看，發現他的雙耳都患有嚴重的耳漏，膿水眼看就要流出耳朵外了。

en.t: When I looked closely, I saw that both of his ears were badly discharging, and pus looked ready to run out at any moment.

units.source_text: 「這怎麼能行呢，很痛吧？」我略帶誇張滿臉驚訝地問他。

en.t: "This will never do. It must hurt terribly, doesn't it?" I asked him, exaggerating my surprise a little.

units.source_text: 「都怪我在大雨中拽著你跑，對不起啊！」

en.t: "It is my fault for dragging you along through that heavy rain. I am sorry!"

units.source_text: 我用女人般的柔聲細語向他道歉，之後，下樓取來棉棒和酒精，

en.t: I apologized to him in a soft, womanlike voice, then went downstairs and brought back cotton swabs and alcohol,

units.source_text: 讓竹一把頭枕在我的膝蓋上，小心翼翼地為他清理耳朵。

en.t: had Takeichi rest his head on my lap, and carefully cleaned his ears for him.

units.source_text: 竹一似乎一點也沒覺察出這是我偽善的詭計。

en.t: Takeichi seemed not to notice at all that this was a hypocritical trick of mine.

units.source_text: 「你這傢伙，肯定會被女孩子迷戀上的！」

en.t: "You are the sort of guy girls are sure to fall for!"

units.source_text: 枕在我膝蓋上的竹一，說著愚蠢的奉承話。

en.t: Takeichi, lying with his head on my lap, said this foolish bit of flattery.
